scope: Read-only review of the rental execution clarification and its STATUS/handoff entries. Documentation only; no source changes, new tests, services, cloud calls or pressure windows.
latestUserGoal: Quickly select a defensible higher rate, then repeat one fixed rate twice. The fixed 50/40 short-only proposal is not adopted.

algorithmAndQuota.independentCompleteShortWindows: 50/s diagnostic; an evidence-based single optimization requires its same-50/s comparison. Valid passes may expand by four to 200/800/3200/5000; with L/U use integer midpoint, without L halve the first failing rate under the original rule. Preserve the candidate margin confirmation before formal runs.
algorithmAndQuota.boundaryQualification: Only complete, correct, resource-valid, collection/generator-valid ordinary performance misses with recovery verified within the unchanged 60-second budget may support U. Unoffered load, dropped work, invalid measurement or resource interruptions do not automatically become a service upper bound.
algorithmAndQuota.largeRateAdmission: Each increase needs evidence from actual iteration latency, the unchanged 512 exclusive relationships, PTS CPU/RSS, drops, queueing and target resources. No blind pool expansion or relaxed criteria to obtain a larger number.
algorithmAndQuota.formalQualification: One candidate with original 160/400 ms margins, then the same frozen R/source/binary/environment/tools/scenario/distribution for two complete 180-second runs. Formal P95/P99 remains 200/500 ms; first failure ends the group without a replacement success pair.

claimBoundaries.stableTPS: Actual verified mutations/180 seconds for each formal run, with the lower passing result reported as repeated stable throughput.
claimBoundaries.noUpperBound: Report only an observed lower bound when U is absent; do not claim a mathematical maximum.

rentalTimeAndPreparation.preRentalPreparation: Account/quota/RAM or private STS configuration, SSH public key, Shanghai VPC/subnet/security groups, and a saved non-running PTS JMeter draft when supported. The actual ECS private IP/control credential/private JSON is bound after the host exists; no debug or calibration load is added.
rentalTimeAndPreparation.unprovedCloudCapabilitiesDisclosed: Actual Start/Stop permissions, SaaS CSV/thread allocation, private collector connectivity, process RSS access and clock precision remain subject to necessary cloud admission. Local wiring/read-only scene checks do not establish these.

reviewFindings: PASS after clarifying that midpoint search requires both L and U, while no-L failures retain the original halving branch.
PASS after explicitly adding resource-validity to boundary qualification.
No code or threshold change, extra capacity round, promised 5000/s result, or promised 14-minute rental completion was introduced.
